name: What is involved in the process of optimizing a website for AEO?
description: AEO optimization involves keyword research for user questions, structuring content in Q&A format, using schema markup, and ensuring technical site health.

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the process of optimizing a website for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optimizing a website for AEO involves several key steps. First, it requires thorough keyword research to identify common questions users ask related to your business. Next, content needs to be restructured and written in a question-and-answer format, focusing on clarity and conciseness to directly address these questions. This includes using structured data (schema markup) to help search engines understand your content's context. Technical aspects like website speed and mobile-friendliness also play a role, as search engines prioritize accessible and fast-loading sites for direct answers. Regular monitoring and refinement based on performance data are crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimization involves keyword research for user questions, structuring content in Q&A format, using schema markup, and ensuring technical site health.
